name: Cable preacher curl
cue: Elbows on the pad; curl up, lower all the way.
research: Seated cable preacher curl, a free-standing preacher bench (seat 0.24 H, pad 0.36 H wide sloping 45 deg from vertical on one column between the shins) with a straight bar on a low pulley (0.075 H, in a fork on the column's base) in a column 0.6 H (1.1 m) in front of the bench, the cable passing in front of it. The body is the machine preacher curl's (research.json biomech.preacher_curl): trunk 10 deg forward, hips about 100, knees 90, feet flat, the backs of the upper arms on the pad (shoulder flexion 55 relative to the trunk, abduction 9), the elbows at the pad's lower end, the elbow from 10 to 120 deg with the upper arm still, supinated grip. The pad runs from the armpit to just above the elbow and is placed to meet the back of the arm (fit entry in the patch). Design values from the standard technique description, not a measured trial. The straight bar (20 in, 0.285 H, 25 mm thick, the grips shoulder width apart) rides in the fists (bone-attached on the hand, so it cannot slip and the grip tunnel stays along the left-right axis, tilt under 0.2 deg); the cable is on the middle of the bar and leaves it 64 deg below horizontal at the bottom and 65 deg at the top (the moment arm against the cable, the sine of the angle between the forearm and the cable, is 0.60 at the bottom, 0.99 mid-range and 0.59 at the top). Cable 1:1 to the stack. Geometry: design/cableB/pc.mjs.

targets.note: the research values of the machine preacher curl; the bar and cable are design values (standard technique), not a measured trial

camera.note: The preacher curl view (az 90, el 10), turned 10 deg toward the front and raised 6 deg (az 80, el 16): the near biceps reads as the dominant oval in the V between upper arm and forearm at the top, with the far biceps smaller above it, and the cable under the pad shows where the load comes from. Fill 0.62: the seated figure is short, and a larger arm reads better on a phone. The bench stands on a floor rail from the seat post to the pad column and a foot plate under the feet (a plate under everything would run under the exercise name on the phone); the column crops at the top.
